Requesting information about your complaint
Every report we receive is important, however, not every submission results in an investigation. Once submitted, we will review your complaint for relevance and completeness. If you have identified yourself, a reviewing official may contact you for further information. It is important to note that you might not be contacted by an investigator but that does not mean your complaint is not being investigated. Due to the high volume of complaints we receive, it is not possible to contact every complainant. The Hotline will not be able to confirm receipt of your complaint or respond to any inquiries about action taken on your complaint.
You may request information about your complaint through the OIG Freedom of Information Act officer. Remember to phrase your request in terms of a search for records pertinent to your complaint, not status.

Allegation details:
HHS employee, contractor, or grantee: No
Allegation type: Improper billing
Healthcare program: Medicaid (Medi-Cal)
Program type: Prescription Drug / Pharmacy
Date of activity: 4/20/2026
Is the activity still happening: Yes
Previously reported: Yes, to California Board of Pharmacy (#PHAR-20260423-23728)

Subject information:
Business: Garfield Beach CVS, LLC (Store #9785)
Category: Pharmacy
DBA: CVS Pharmacy
Address: 2006 W Ave J, Lancaster, CA 93536
Phone: 661-945-2729
State License: CA Board of Pharmacy Facility License # PHY 50381

Narrative:
The complainant reports fraudulent billing manipulation and beneficiary harm involving Medi-Cal Rx funds at CVS Store #9785. A Diazepam 5 mg prescription was transmitted at 9:05 AM on April 20, 2026. Medi-Cal Rx authorized and paid the claim at 9:06 AM, 9:40 AM, and 9:45 AM. At 9:45 AM, the pharmacist issued a constructive refusal and manually reversed the claims, overriding state approval. This caused a 16-hour interruption in a supervised taper program, resulting in severe autonomic distress, CNS destabilization, tremors, and loss of consciousness. Medication was not obtained until 1:01 AM on April 21, 2026. Supporting evidence includes Medi-Cal Rx logs, call logs, receipts, medical necessity letters, and PDMP records.

Complainant: Nicolas Hernandez. No confidentiality restrictions.
